verdicts.reason: A: the GLACIER wordmark floats centred over nothing and does not line up with the headline's left edge. The can circle nearly touches the top and bottom of the canvas. The badge and CTA cluster on the right sits low and lines up with neither the copy block nor the image, so the layout feels arbitrary. B: GLACIER, the one-line headline, the body copy and the badges share a clean left edge, and the CTA on the right reads well as a banner. Its flaws: the body copy leaves an orphaned 'and bottles.', the badges are jammed against the bottom edge and cut off from the CTA, and the can's 'SOLSTICE' label is unreadably small in both.
